import pathlib,json,csv,statistics,math,collections,subprocess,datetime,re,hashlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path('/Users/noir/code/splashery');out=root/'docs/audits/perf-2026-10'
load=lambda n:json.loads((out/n).read_text())
rows=load('measurements.json');catalog=load('catalogue.json');meta=load('methodology.json');inventory={s['id']:s for s in load('static-inventory.json')}
assert len(rows)==2*len(catalog)==684
keys=[(r['device'],r['id']) for r in rows]
assert len(set(keys))==len(keys)
assert set(keys)=={(d,t['id']) for t in catalog for d in ['phone','desktop']}
assert all(r['status']=='ok' for r in rows)
assert all(r['visible']=='visible' and r['renderer']=='webgl2' and not r['soundEnabled'] for r in rows)
assert all(r['profile']==('low' if r['device']=='phone' else 'high') for r in rows)
assert all('Apple M3 Pro' in r['gpu'] and r['canvas']['width']>0 and r['canvas']['height']>0 for r in rows)
assert all(not r['pageErrors'] and not r['consoleErrors'] and not r['workerTimingErrors'] for r in rows)
series=load('frame-series.json');series_by={s['series']:s for s in series}
assert len(series_by)==len(series)==len(rows)*4
assert [s['series'] for s in series]==list(range(len(series)))
assert set((s['device'],s['id'],s['window'],s['event']) for s in series)=={(r['device'],r['id'],w,e) for r in rows for w in ['idle','tap'] for e in ['frameend','postrender']}
for s in series:assert (rows[s['measurementIndex']]['device'],rows[s['measurementIndex']]['id'])==(s['device'],s['id'])
frames=collections.defaultdict(list)
with (out/'frame-samples.csv').open(newline='') as f:
 for r in csv.DictReader(f):
  s=series_by[int(r['series'])];frames[(s['device'],s['id'],s['window'],s['event'])].append((int(r['sample']),float(r['interval_ms'])))
for s in series:assert len(frames[(s['device'],s['id'],s['window'],s['event'])])==s['samples']
frame_hash=hashlib.sha256((out/'frame-samples.csv').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
collector_vectors_match=None
prior_path=out/'validation.json'
if prior_path.exists():
 prior=json.loads(prior_path.read_text())
 if prior.get('frameCsvSha256AtCollectorEqualityCheck')==frame_hash and prior.get('collectorVectorsMatch') is True:collector_vectors_match=True
collector_dump_dir=pathlib.Path(next((a.split('=',1)[1] for a in sys.argv if a.startswith('--collector-dumps=')),str(out)))
if all((collector_dump_dir/(d+'.json')).exists() for d in ['phone','desktop']):
 for d in ['phone','desktop']:
  for r in json.loads((collector_dump_dir/(d+'.json')).read_text()):
   for w in ['idle','tap']:
    for e,k in [('frameend','intervalsMs'),('postrender','renderIntervalsMs')]:assert [v for i,v in frames[(d,r['id'],w,e)]]==r[w][k]
 collector_vectors_match=True
network=collections.defaultdict(list)
with (out/'network.csv').open(newline='') as f:
 for r in csv.DictReader(f):network[(r['device'],r['id'])].append(r)
for r in rows:
 k=(r['device'],r['id']);assert r['firstReadyRenderMs']>0 and r['navigationStartTimestamp']>0 and (not r.get('workerResources') or r['timeOriginMs']>0)
 assert r['firstReadyRenderMs']<r['idle']['startMs']<r['idle']['endMs']<=r['tap']['startMs']<r['tap']['endMs']
 assert r['tableHeapBytes']==r['heapAfterSettle']['usedSize'] and r['tableHeapBytes']>0
 assert r['tableSplats']==r['settledBaseAndPictureSplats']+r['rigAddonSplats']+r['fluidLayerCapacity']
 if r['kind']=='captured':
  asset=inventory[r['id']]['lite' if r['device']=='phone' else 'full'];assert r['baseSplats']==asset['splats'],(k,r['baseSplats'],asset)
 for w in ['idle','tap']:
  window=r[w];assert window['elapsedMs']>=4995 and window['endMs']-window['startMs']==window['elapsedMs']
  for event,nkey,mkey,pkey in [('frameend','samples','medianMs','p95Ms'),('postrender','renderIntervalSamples','renderIntervalMedianMs','renderIntervalP95Ms')]:
   observations=frames[(*k,w,event)];assert [i for i,v in observations]==list(range(len(observations)))
   values=[v for i,v in observations];assert len(values)==window[nkey] and all(v>0 for v in values)
   if values:
    assert math.isclose(statistics.median(values),window[mkey],abs_tol=1e-8)
    assert math.isclose(sorted(values)[math.ceil(.95*len(values))-1],window[pkey],abs_tol=1e-8)
   else:assert window[mkey] is None and window[pkey] is None
   if event=='frameend':assert len(values)>0
  assert window['renderIntervalSamples']==max(0,window['renderCount']-1)
 net=network[k]
 assert all((not n['request_error'] or (r['id']=='screen' and n['request_error']=='net::ERR_ABORTED' and n['canceled']=='True')) and (not n['status'] or int(n['status'])<400) for n in net)
 payload=lambda cutoff:sum(int(n['payload_bytes']) for n in net if n['finish_ms_for_cutoff'] and float(n['finish_ms_for_cutoff'])<=cutoff)
 assert payload(r['idle']['startMs'])==r['openingPayloadBytes']
 assert payload(r['firstReadyRenderMs'])==r['firstFramePayloadBytes']
 assert r['openingPayloadBytes']>=r['firstFramePayloadBytes']>0
probes=load('site-probes.json')['records'];census=[p for p in probes if p['kind']=='additional-splat-census']
assert len(census)==2*sum(bool(s.get('rigAddonSplats')) or s['id']=='fluid-lab' for s in inventory.values())
for p in census:
 assert not p['errors'];assert p['census']['addonSplats']==p['expectedStaticAddon']
 if p['id']=='fluid-lab':assert p['census']['fluid']['mode']=='sync' and p['census']['fluid']['layerCapacity']>0
for p in probes:
 assert not p['errors']
 if p['kind']=='gallery':
  assert p['thumbnails']['cards']==(342 if p['labs'] else 319) and p['thumbnails']['loaded']==p['thumbnails']['cards'] and not p['heavyAtInitial']
  thumb_entries=[x for x in p['all'] if x['url'].endswith('/thumb.webp')]
  assert len(thumb_entries)==p['thumbnails']['cards']
  expected=sum(x['thumbnail']['bytes'] for x in inventory.values() if p['labs'] or not x['labs'])
  assert sum(x['encodedBodySize'] for x in thumb_entries if x['transferSize']>0)==expected
 if p['kind']=='gif-fallback':assert 'error' not in p['result'] and any('/vendor/omggif/' in x['url'] for x in p['after'])
 if p['kind']=='explicit-depth-loader':assert p['result'].get('sessionCreated') and any('/vendor/depth-anything-v2-small/' in x['url'] for x in p['after'])
 if p['kind']=='sound-enabled-dice':assert any('/assets/sounds/' in x['url'] for x in p['after'])
cmd=lambda *args:subprocess.check_output(args,cwd=root,text=True).strip()
assert cmd('git','branch','--show-current')=='codex/perf-audit'
assert not cmd('git','diff',meta['baseline'],'--','.',':(exclude)docs/audits/perf-2026-10.md',':(exclude)docs/audits/perf-2026-10/')
ply=load('lossless-ply-check.json');assert ply['decodedEquality'] and ply['framedAndPrunedEquality'] and ply['savingBytes']==1395402
assert all(p.suffix in ['.csv','.json'] for p in out.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
# Validate every source locator in the report against this frozen checkout.
report=(root/'docs/audits/perf-2026-10.md').read_text();locators=set(re.findall(r'`((?:src|tests)/[^`\s:]+):(\d+)`',report))
for file,line in locators:assert 1<=int(line)<=len((root/file).read_text().splitlines()),(file,line)
public=sum(not t['labs'] for t in catalog);labs=len(catalog)-public
receipt={'validatedAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'baseline':meta['baseline'],'branch':cmd('git','branch','--show-current'),'matrixRows':len(rows),'publicToys':public,'labsToys':labs,'frameSeries':len(series),'collectorVectorsMatch':collector_vectors_match,'frameCsvSha256AtCollectorEqualityCheck':frame_hash if collector_vectors_match else None,'frameSampleRows':sum(map(len,frames.values())),'networkRows':sum(map(len,network.values())),'abortedRequests':[{'device':r['device'],'id':r['id'],'url':n['url'],'error':n['request_error']} for r in rows for n in network[(r['device'],r['id'])] if n['request_error']],'pageErrors':0,'consoleErrors':0,'workerTimingErrors':0,'sourceLocatorsInBounds':len(locators),'supplementalCensusRows':len(census),'windows':len(rows)*2,'minimumWindowMs':min(r[w]['elapsedMs'] for r in rows for w in ['idle','tap']),'checks':['exact catalog coverage and unique device/toy cells','renderer, GPU, profile, visibility, sound and canvas','sample counts, sequential indexes, medians and p95 from raw CSV','opening and first-ready payload totals from network CSV','captured file counts, rig add-ons and fluid capacity','gallery thumbnail coverage and lazy-load probes','source unchanged and allowed output boundary'],'source':pathlib.Path('/tmp/splashery-validate.py').read_text()}
(out/'validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in receipt.items() if k not in ['source','checks']}))
